title: Apple Releases 27.2.1 HomeView Software Update
snippet: Apple today released new 27.2.1 software for the HomeView, marking the first post-release software update for the device. There are no notes that mention what's new in the update, but Apple does have a HomeView software support document that should have details in the near future. The 27.2.1 updates for other platforms were primarily focused on security, but the HomeView Software 27.2.1 does not include any published CVE entries. title: Carlyle’s Jenkins Warns on Rush to Fund AI Data Centers
snippet: Carlyle’s Mark Jenkins warned investors against rushing to finance AI data centers, arguing that a huge pipeline of new capacity means they can afford to be selective. He highlighted growing concentration risk, uncertainty over AI business models and tougher conditions for speculative developers, while saying well-capitalized hyperscalers are likely to benefit as communities demand more from data-center projects. (Source: Bloomberg)
